2921-7084-8338.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing another nonland creature you control
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on them.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the land
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Shuttlecraft Galileo triggers, creating a 1/1 red Officer creature token
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on them.
Repeat.

4289-4770-4885-6090.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it and Arahbo trigger.
Resolve the Arahbo trigger, creating a 1/1 Cat creature token.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Cat token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1339-1832-2034-4699.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
1339-1832-2034-4699.description:
Activate Unfulfilled Desires by paying {1} and 1 life, causing you to loot.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Insect, adding {C}{C}
When the Insect dies, Overgrowth Elemental triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

1981-2034-2415-6772.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature, adding {C}{C}
When the creature dies, Syr Vondam and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Syr Vondam trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Syr Vondam
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a +1/+1 counter on it and has lifelink

3693-4613-8036.description:
Activate Christine Chapel by using Walking Ballista's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain 1 life due to its lifelink.
Christine Chapel triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

6798-7084-7893.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Thranduil, triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more oil counters on it

1987-2187-3120.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
1987-2187-3120.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Possessed Skaab.
When Possessed Skaab enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-2187-3120.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

240-643-997.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies as an Egg due to Maskwood Nexus, Atla triggers, revealing a creature card from your library and putting it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat as desired / able.
240-643-997.notes: The combo can continue as long as there are creature cards in your library.

206-2457-3129-4289.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Mirror-Mad Phantasm

2084-7193.description: Activate Omni-Changeling by paying {1}{U}, shuffling Omni-Changeling into your library and milling your entire library due to it not having a card named Mirror-Mad Phantasm in it.

628-5256-7188.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Heirloom Auntie.
When Heirloom Auntie dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability
Repeat.

775-1308-1409.description:
Activate Jewel Thief by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Jewel Thief enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Jewel Thief.
Resolve the Jewel Thief trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

1530-2061.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Second Chance and Extravagant Replication trigger.
Resolve the Extravagant Replication trigger, creating a token copy of Second Chance.
Resolve the Second Chance trigger, causing you to sacrifice it and take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more brick counters on it

1805-4331-4993-6709.easyPrerequisites: Ballad of the Black Flag's fourth chapter ability has triggered this turn
1805-4331-4993-6709.description:
Activate Pyramid of the Pantheon by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Manifold Key by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Pyramid of the Pantheon.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Manifold Key from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Manifold Key by paying {0}.
Repeat.

64-232-1235-5026.description:
Cast Twinflame by paying {3}{R}{R}, targeting any two creatures.
Holding priority, cast Reverberate by paying its mana cost, copying Twinflame, with the copy targeting Priest of Urabrask and Warden of the Eye.
Resolve the copy of Twinflame, creating a token copy of Priest of Urabrask and Warden of the Eye with haste.
When the Priest of Urabrask and Warden of the Eye tokens enter, they trigger.
Resolve the Priest of Urabrask trigger, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Warden of the Eye trigger, returning Reverberate from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

512-3043-4241.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures with defender.
512-3043-4241.description:
Activate Karn by paying {1}, causing Halo Fountain to become a creature.
Activate Axebane Guardian by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}.
Activate Halo Fountain's second ability by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and then untapping it and Axebane Guardian, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.
512-3043-4241.notes: With the excess mana, you can use it on Halo Fountain's first ability, tapping and untapping it to create creature tokens.

147-2438-3495.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-2438-3495.description:
Cast Breach the Multiverse by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Breach the Multiverse.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Breach the Multiverse, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage
Resolve the Breach the Multiverse copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
147-2438-3495.notes: Breach the Multiverse can put all creature cards from all graveyards and libraries onto the battlefield under your control infinitely. It will also infinitely mill all players.

2034-2279-3000-5220-6961.notablePrerequisites: You control ten or more lands that have different names.
2034-2279-3000-5220-6961.description:
Activate Survey Mechan by sacrificing it.
When Survey Mechan dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Survey Mechan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Quintorius triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Survey Mechan ability, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to draw three cards and gain 3 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Survey Mechan by paying {4}.
Repeat.

2854-3200-4574-6900.easyPrerequisites: Showdown of the Skalds' second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
2854-3200-4574-6900.description:
Cast Urza's Bauble either from your hand by paying {0} or from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Showdown of the Skalds triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Activate Urza's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Urza's Bauble from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

24-2613-4090.description:
Cast Wheel of Misfortune by paying {2}{R}, choosing an arbitrarily large number and having Wheel of Misfortune deal that much damage to Spiteful Sliver instead of you due to Pariah if you chose the largest number.
Spiteful Sliver triggers, dealing that much damage to an applicable target.
24-2613-4090.notes: If you didn't choose the highest number, Wheel of Misfortune will deal damage to the opponent(s) who did equal to that number.

439-5256-6481.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Arashin Sovereign.
When Arashin Sovereign dies, it triggers, putting itself from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill cards equal to Arashin Sovereign's power, ultimately milling Arashin Sovereign.
Colossal Grave-Reaver's second ability triggers, putting Arashin Sovereign from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

4050-4577-4647-5046.notablePrerequisites: Magnanimous Magistrate has at least one reprieve counter.
4050-4577-4647-5046.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Martyr for the Cause, adding one mana of any color.
Martyr for the Cause dies, triggering itself and Magnanimous Magistrate twice.
Resolve both Martyr for the Cause triggers, causing you to put two reprieve counters on Magnanimous Magistrate.
Resolve the first Magnanimous Magistrate trigger, choosing not to remove any counters.
Remove the second Magnanimous Magistrate trigger, causing you to remove two reprieve counters from Magnanimous Magistrate and return Martyr for the Cause from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1912-3068-3525.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Jenson.
Jenson does not have summoning sickness.
1912-3068-3525.description:
Activate Jenson by paying {3} and tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untaping Jenson.
Repeat.

3055-4050-5145.notablePrerequisites: Gift of Immortality attached to Archon of Falling Stars.
3055-4050-5145.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Archon of Falling Stars, adding one mana of any color.
Archon of Falling Stars dies, triggering itself and Gift of Immortality.
Resolve the Gift of Immortality trigger, returning Archon of Falling Stars from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Archon of Falling Stars trigger, returning Gift of Immortality from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Archon of Falling Stars.
Repeat.
